power_examples.display_rounding: Probabilities multiplied by 100 and rounded to one decimal percentage point.
power_examples.conditions: iid independent-family paired binary outcomes; alpha .025 per claim; practical margin .10; beneficial scenario p10=.30,p01=.10 versus separate exclusion scenario p10=.15,p01=.15.

cost_claim.basis: 800 multiplied by retained historical two-arm per-pair API illustration $2.125539. Excludes strong anchors, engineering, fixture and local-compute cost; not a four-cell estimate.

power_examples.boundary: A true gain equal to the practical margin should usually remain inconclusive; rejecting zero and establishing a worthwhile nonzero margin have different power.

scientific_scope.observed_live_comparison: Independent versus serial candidate formation under a common central controller; not live gossip or decentralized planning.
scientific_scope.controller_pilot: 12 trajectories, four matched blocks, two development task families. A/B shared first-milestone candidates/scouts are declared setup, not independent end-to-end replication. Improves diagnosis and policy selection only.
scientific_scope.four_cell_future_comparison: P-G versus O-B is a package contrast. O-G and P-B separate dissemination and decision placement under one common policy, safety/authority services, offered resources and matched credible failover. Full four-cell scope remains unfinished.
scientific_scope.primary_endpoint_recommendation: Exact source public-policy complete and frozen by common active deadline/offered budget, then complete inherited/new private acceptance and valid promotion after the global cohort freeze barrier.
scientific_scope.independence: One independently sampled previously held-out family per pair for the proposed iid analysis. Repeated seeds, scenarios, milestones, related variants and reused baselines remain clustered. New repositories alone do not establish independence.
scientific_scope.timing: Keep early terminal failures unsuccessful through the horizon. Separate active source-freeze time, cohort waiting, private adjudication and final promotion; do not count early stopping as a speed win.
scientific_scope.preservation: Keep inherited correctness inside all-or-nothing acceptance. Any separate co-primary preservation claim requires a frozen rule and error allocation; unsafe publication is a protocol failure.
scientific_scope.limits: Same-host offline dispatch and bounded-proposal studies do not complete autonomous multi-turn tool-loop or multi-host investigations.

recommended_decision.exclusion: Upper endpoint < +.10 rules out that worthwhile gain only in the tested population/model/budget contract; upper <0 is stronger evidence of harm.
recommended_decision.otherwise: Inconclusive; no outcome-driven change of margin, method or sample size.
recommended_decision.error_allocation: Existing design proposes alpha .025 each if either formation or live protocol may satisfy one jointly protected research claim. Select allocation and method before outcomes.
recommended_decision.stopping: Freeze fixed sample and all handling of failed/missing runs before execution. No efficacy peeking, selective replacements or automatic extension. Incomplete cohorts do not receive confirmatory declarations.

held_out_registry_audit.finding: No executable frozen confirmatory family registry identified in the inspected repository plans and matching file inventory.
held_out_registry_audit.scope: Checked authored filenames matching registry, confirmatory, study-plan and followup-design, excluding generated runs/results and HTML; inspected current confirmatory v4, live-gossip v2 and controller-pilot plans. This is a bounded source audit, not a claim about files outside the repository.
held_out_registry_audit.exclusions: Graph/Calendar and derivatives, warehouse/job-queue, and every other family used for development or controller/fixture selection.
held_out_registry_audit.required_work: Select a target population and inclusion/exclusion rules; independently author/select and freeze the family registry; select estimator, alpha, effect margin, sample size, model/interface/controller/budget, order, fixed fault mixture and sealed acceptance contract before confirmatory outcomes.
